info.name: ITSOFTLAB360 - Complete API Testing Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for testing every endpoint of the ITSOFTLAB360 ecosystem.

Includes:
- Authentication & Portal Routing Guard
- SuperAdmin & Franchise Dashboards
- SaaS Products Management
- Internal Users (IT, Admin, Sales, Accountant)
- Franchise Onboarding Workflow (Sales -> Accountant -> IT Provisioning)
- Active Franchises & Profiles Management
- Franchise Team Management (Franchise Admin, Sales, IT, Accountant)
- Client Sales & Onboarding (ClientLicenseRequest -> ClientInvoice -> IT Fulfill)
- Client Invoices & Payment Recording
- Client Organizations & SaaS Subscriptions (HRMSM, CRM, LMS, etc.)
- Organization Users, Remote Provisioning, Multi-Product Linking & SSO Launch Tokens
- External Software License Verification API

item.name: 04. Franchise Onboarding Workflow
item.description:
End-to-end lifecycle for selling and provisioning a new Franchise partner:
1. Sales creates FranchiseRequest (PENDING)
2. Accountant reviews and Approves or Rejects
3. Accountant generates Invoice (APPROVED -> INVOICE_GENERATED)
4. Invoice is marked as Paid (PAID)
5. IT completes onboarding and creates the Franchise instance & catalog (COMPLETED)

item.name: 08. Franchise Client Sales, Billing & IT Provisioning
item.description:
The complete Franchise-to-Client Onboarding Pipeline:
1. Franchise Sales raises ClientLicenseRequest
2. Guard: Cannot sell products not held in franchise catalog
3. Franchise Accountant generates ClientInvoice
4. Client payment clears (Mark Paid -> status='paid')
5. Franchise IT fulfills request: Provisions Organization, Subscriptions, and Organization Administrator with 0 license seat consumption!

item.name: 12. Organization Users, Provisioning & SSO Launch
item.description:
Complete user provisioning, seat limits, multi-product linking, and SSO launch token generation:
- Streamlined Provisioning: calls remote API, maps user into central database, decrements 1 seat
- Multi-Product Linking: Assign same user to CRM/ERP without duplicating central record
- License Limit Enforcement: Prevents seat over-allocation with 400 Bad Request
- Revoke Product: Frees up 1 license seat immediately
- SSO Token: Generates HMAC-SHA256 signed JWT token for seamless 1-click product launch
